content: Kusà a indiir byanswà, mɛ kan'swaŋ naa bàtwab atàsà ndɔ̈ɔ̈m, ngyamàkà, mbɔ̈ɔ̈n, an'tɔɔn ntɔn baar banswà,
ntɔn amfum, anà baar abye anà ikɔ̈b, ntɔn bi ikäl anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ aŋàtɔlà mpem, wà duu unsà inzaam anà uyɔl banswà.
Abi indiir a ntsà ufàkyey Nzam awà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi,
awà akwen naa baar banswà bàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà bàtöl muyɔ̈b ndandaa.
Ntɔn Nzam wà mwɛy, mfurboo mwɛy mpɛl uboo a Nzam anà baar, baal Klistɔ Yɛsu,
awà kàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ŋàkwo asànaa nkwiy ntɔn baar banswà. Abun, nde kàtɛ imbäl, umpal làkwe taaŋ.
Ntɔn abun mɛ, mɛ Nzam kan'si mukäl un'kyeey anà ntööm, un'lɔɔŋ a baar mpa abà Ayudà unsà làkwikilà anà ndandaa. Mɛ in'tà anki loor, wɛɛ mɛ an'tɛn ndandaa.
Abun, mɛɛ in'kwen naa abaal bàyamà kikal kyanswà, bàsɛɛn an'kɔɔ in'kyɛɛl u du, ukɔɔn nkyɛl anà an'sye.
Ntɔn akà akaar, wɛy ba bàbwäär ipfɛy aŋàbwaŋ mpa ipà nswɛn, ikɔɔn akal anà ntwɛn mbɔɔn. Wɛy ba bàkɔɔn atɔŋ ntswe, bàkɔɔn abwaar indiir a wɔl, an'yak, itàkal ipfɛy a ntal mbɔɔn,
wɛɛ, isal aŋàbwaŋ byan'kwo ntɔn akaar bàfàkyään inzaam.
Wɛy un'kaar uwɛl an'lwɛŋ a duu anà unkyeey wanswà.
Mɛ, mɛ impà anki mbwo akà un'kaar mulɔŋ, itàkal muwal ikɔ̈b udu a abaal. Wɛy nde ukäl unsà duu.
Ntɔn ya yà naa bàtàboom Adam kusà, Ɛva ungö.
Waa kà Adam anki bàkür, wɛɛ un'kaar, ungö bun'kür, nde kàbü u man'be.
Itàkal abun, nde asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a mböör a baan, isàkal naa nde wà uboo a làkwikilà, ukwen, un'kyɛɛl anà unsà làbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
